spec.note: Declared before new FOM solves. Preserve original 1/2/2/5 percent pilot mesh screens. Additional 0.1 percent output targets concern reference-label accuracy, not relaxation of the field criterion. Finite boundary sampling is not validation everywhere in the box.

geometry.rationale: Disjoint enclosed ellipses leave a connected solid. Nearest periodic images suffice; farther translations increase at least one coordinate separation. Circle gaps are lower bounds, not exact ligaments.
geometry.note: Jacobian positivity checked at 66 points per Tri6; not an everywhere proof.

scope: B-only numerical preflight, not full-domain stability, contact, uniqueness or asymptotic mesh-convergence proof. All failed increments remain in attempts.
